verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents extensive APIs, a full-featured CLI (sf), and developer tooling that historically has offered broad programmatic access to CRM objects and metadata (salesforce-docs-7, salesforce-gh-1–8, salesforce-comm-3), supporting the general claim that most sales-cloud data/operations are scriptable. However, none of the evidence explicitly confirms 1:1 parity between every UI action (e.g., new AI/Agentforce features, forecasting UI, dashboards) and API equivalents, and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable (salesforce-probe-2 returned 404s), leaving API completeness unverified. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity documentation, independent test/hands-on confirmation that AI/Agentforce and forecasting features are fully API-accessible, and a public OpenAPI/schema reference.
